title: Maximize the Number of Target Nodes After Connecting Trees I
summary: For each node of tree 1, count nodes within k edges (both trees) after one temporary edge joins tree 1 to tree 2; a node counts itself.
officialConstraints: n, m up to 1000 (doocs write-up). k bounds not obtained from a source.
visualizationNotes: Visualization accepts at most 40 nodes per tree.

examples.label: Sourced example (k = 1)
